expected = store.publication_snapshot(root)

base = root / 'investing/assets/equities/aapl'
old = json.loads((base / 'cycles/2024Q2/2024-05-03-r1/review.json').read_text())
src = json.loads((base / 'data/sources/narrative.json').read_text())
method = json.loads((base / 'data/analysis/method.json').read_text())
analysis = '''# Synthetic business evidence checkpoint

Scope: fictional teaching evidence only; latest assessment cutoff 2024-08-31T23:59:59+00:00. This is a 2026-authored reconstruction, not a contemporaneous forecast or Apple diligence.

Question: what do the supplied business passages establish about operating drivers and competing risks?

Read coverage: data/original-extract.json, sections Business, MD&A and Risk factors, mirrored exactly in data/sources/narrative.json. Business says renewals support recurring services revenue and hardware demand is cyclical. MD&A says units declined 5% and services grew 8%; currency and mix also changed. Risk factors identifies distribution concentration and antitrust remedies as potential margin pressures. These are synthetic assertions, not verified real company facts.

Interpretation: recurring services may cushion weaker hardware demand, but segment weights, renewal rates and a price/volume reconciliation are absent. The strongest competing explanation is currency/mix rather than improved underlying demand. The 5% and 8% refer to unlike measures: they cannot be added, netted or weighted without additional inputs. No combined growth calculation is justified. Recurrence does not prove competitive durability or stable margins when distribution and regulatory risks remain.

This answers only the supplied-excerpt business question. Unread and unavailable: financial statement notes, governance/proxy and full filing remainder. Liquidity, accounting quality, incentives, segment economics and full competitive diligence remain unknown; none are certified complete.

The older valuation output is literally 'analysis'; its self-check flags do not establish valuation. The synthetic USD 10 source has no usable dated quote passage, share count, earnings/cash flow or valuation model. A valuation conclusion remains pending. Market source is entirely absent; synthesis therefore remains pending.

Selected analysis windows retain the existing method: short 0–3 months, medium 3–12 months, long 12–60 months from the assessment cutoff. Exploratory one-quarter/1–3-year/5+-year windows are a different convention and are not substituted. These windows do not infer the user's holding period. The existing 2026-11-16 method is uncalibrated; the supplied generic skill supports evidence-bound reasoning but does not calibrate returns.

Short: insufficient_evidence for investment returns. Conditional operating resilience requires renewals to offset hardware weakness; invalidate on deteriorating renewal evidence or continued hardware contraction. Need next-period comparable operating bridge and dated valuation inputs.
Medium: insufficient_evidence for investment returns. Services growth may persist but currency/mix and regulatory margin pressure can reverse apparent progress. Need segment weights, renewal/cohort trends and remedy economics.
Long: insufficient_evidence for investment returns. No durable moat, normalized margins or terminal assumptions are established. Need multi-period original statements, competition, reinvestment and governance evidence. No rating, target, probabilities or benchmark returns follow.

Self-check: passage references match the exact synthetic original; numerical rates are copied without invalid aggregation. Counterevidence and unavailable sections are explicit. This is author self-check, not independent review.
'''
digest = hashlib.sha256(analysis.encode()).hexdigest()
directory = 'investing/assets/equities/aapl/cycles/2024Q2/2024-08-31-partial3'
unit = dict(consumed={'narrative':dict(version=src['identity'],projection=src['projection'])}, analysis_inputs={'method':{**{k:method[k] for k in ['kind','authored_at','projection','content_ref','content_digest']},'version':method['identity']}}, output=dict(path=directory+'/business.md',digest=digest),verification=directory+'/business-check.json')
gaps = ['Market source absent; market-scenarios pending.', 'Valuation predecessor is placeholder text; substantive valuation pending.', 'Dependent synthesis pending.', 'Full filing notes and governance absent; broader diligence unsupported.']
horizons = {}
for name, window in [('short','0–3 months'),('medium','3–12 months'),('long','12–60 months')]:
    horizons[name] = dict(judgment='insufficient_evidence; '+window+' from 2024-08-31T23:59:59+00:00; conditional operating reasoning in business.md, no return conclusion', evidence=[directory+'/business.md',src['raw_ref']], invalidation_triggers=['Renewal deterioration, hardware weakness or adverse regulatory margin evidence; obtain comparable operating and valuation inputs.'])
review = dict(version=1,id='partial3',fiscal=old['fiscal'],cutoff='2024-08-31T23:59:59+00:00',predecessor='r1',units={'business':unit},research=dict(method='Existing uncalibrated applied scenario method v1, authored 2026-11-16; evidence-bound supplied research-method.md; retained 0–3/3–12/12–60 month convention.',assumptions=['Synthetic passages accepted only as teaching inputs; no holding preference inferred.'],changes=['Added source-grounded bounded business answer; did not carry placeholder valuation forward as substantive completion.'],gaps=gaps,horizons=horizons))
check = dict(version=1,output_digest=digest,checks=dict(sources=True,citations=True,calculations=True,counterevidence=True),unresolved=[])
review['research']['changes'] = 'Added bounded business analysis; placeholder valuation remains pending. Prior run missing-skill-3-checkpoint failed before commit: ValueError: incomplete research envelope; changes required text rather than list. Original journal and draft retained unchanged.'
saved = store.publish(root,'aapl',review,{'business.md':analysis,'business-check.json':json.dumps(check,indent=2)},expected,'missing-skill-3-checkpoint-fixed',complete=False)
after = store.discover(root,'latest','2024-08-31T23:59:59+00:00')
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(out/'discovery-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(before,indent=2))
(out/'discovery-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(after,indent=2))
(out/'result.md').write_text('# Partial continuation\n\n'+json.dumps(saved)+'\n\nRead configuration, all retained outputs/checks, synthetic original Business/MD&A/Risk factors, source metadata, price original, local method and supplied skill/reference/README. Business excerpt answer saved and checked; no full-filing reading claimed. Market data absent; prior valuation was placeholder text; valuation, market-scenarios and synthesis remain pending. All history retained.\n\nShort 0–3, medium 3–12, long 12–60 months anchored at 2024-08-31: investment conclusions insufficient_evidence. Conditional resilience depends on renewals versus hardware weakness; medium/long durability and margins remain unproven. Windows are analytical conventions, not user holding preferences. No external request, installation or real investment validation occurred.\n')
(out/'commands.md').write_text('Commands executed: cat supplied SKILL.md; cat research-method.md and package README; find ROOT -type f; Python imported actual research_store.py and called discover and read every ROOT file; rg helper validation symbols; ls -ld RESULT (exit 1: No such file or directory); apply_patch created ROOT/continue_research.py; Python ROOT/continue_research.py captured snapshot, published complete=False and rediscovered. No network or installs. Publication/discovery observations are preserved in result.md and discovery JSON files.\n')
print(json.dumps(saved)); print(json.dumps(after,indent=2))
